facts.fact: Community newspapers charge $10-30 per column inch for display ads, while metro dailies charge $50-200+.
facts.quote: **Display ads:** $10-30 per column inch for community papers, $50-200+ for metro dailies

facts.fact: A quarter-page newspaper ad costs $200-500 in community papers and $1,000-5,000 in metro dailies.
facts.quote: **Quarter-page ad:** $200-500 in community papers, $1,000-5,000 in metro dailies

facts.fact: Newspaper classified or service directory listings cost $25-100 per week.
Traditional billboards cost $750-3,000 per month in small to mid-size markets.
facts.quote: **Traditional billboards:** $750-3,000/month in small to mid-size markets

facts.fact: Digital billboards on a shared rotation cost $300-1,500 per month.
Bus stop and transit ads cost $300-1,000 per month.
Bench and small-format outdoor ads cost $100-400 per month.
Prime highway billboard locations in larger markets can exceed $10,000 per month.
facts.quote: Prime highway locations in larger markets can exceed $10,000/month.

facts.fact: A Yelp Enhanced Profile costs $300-1,000 per month depending on market.
Yelp Ads cost $150-1,000 per month using cost-per-click pricing.
An Angi basic listing costs $300-500 per month.
facts.quote: **Angi (formerly Angie's List):** $300-500/month for a basic listing

facts.fact: Thumbtack charges per lead, typically $5-50 depending on service type.
facts.quote: **Thumbtack:** Pay per lead, typically $5-50 depending on service type

facts.fact: Industry-specific directories such as Healthgrades, Avvo, and Houzz offer free basic listings and charge $100-500 per month for premium.
facts.quote: **Industry-specific directories** (Healthgrades, Avvo, Houzz): Free basic listings, $100-500/month for premium

facts.fact: Streaming TV advertising is listed at $50-2,000 per month with a $15-35 CPM.
Google Search Ads are listed at $500-5,000 per month with a $20-80 effective CPM.
facts.unit: USD per month; USD effective CPM

facts.fact: Social media advertising is listed at $300-2,000 per month with an $8-15 CPM.
Direct mail campaigns are listed at $1,000-5,000 per campaign, or $150-300 per 1,000 pieces.
Radio advertising is listed at $1,000-5,000 per month with a $5-15 CPM.
Print advertising is listed at $200-2,000 per month with a $20-100 CPM.
Outdoor advertising is listed at $300-3,000 per month with a $3-10 CPM.
Adwave states that TV commercial production is free with Adwave, compared with $1,500-10,000+ for traditional production.
facts.quote: **TV commercial production:** Free with [Adwave](https://adwave.com/how-it-works), $1,500-10,000+ with traditional production

facts.fact: Agency management fees are 15-20% of spend or a $500-2,000 per month flat fee.
facts.quote: **Agency management fees:** 15-20% of spend or $500-2,000/month flat fee

facts.fact: Google Ads management costs $300-1,500 per month.
The SBA recommends that businesses under $5 million in revenue spend 7-8% of gross revenue on marketing.
facts.quote: The SBA recommends 7-8% of gross revenue for businesses under $5 million.

facts.fact: Adwave states that streaming TV advertising starts at $30 a day.
facts.quote: Streaming TV advertising starts at $30 a day with Adwave

facts.fact: Adwave states that a local business spending $500 per month on streaming TV reaches approximately 20,000 local viewers.
facts.quote: A local business spending $500/month on streaming TV reaches approximately 20,000 local viewers

facts.fact: The guide recommends a 50% share of an awareness-focused budget for streaming TV.
facts.quote: **50% streaming TV** for broad local visibility

facts.fact: According to the Adwave page, Google Ads costs continue rising 5-10% annually as more businesses compete for the same searches.
facts.quote: Google Ads costs continue rising 5-10% annually as more businesses compete for the same searches.

facts.fact: Adwave states that its premium streaming TV channels start at $30 a day for local advertisers.
Adwave offers creating a first commercial free through its free-trial link.
